basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graphic designer based in Chicago with a passion for storytelling and video games. I spend my free time exploring different video game narratives, particularly those with a strong story arc like the Telltale Batman series. Being a soccer enthusiast, I follow the US national teams closely, and I also enjoy keeping up with the latest in blockchain technology. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and love to meet new people who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which has given me a keen eye for visual storytelling. My knowledge of video games primarily comes from years of personal interest and playing, as well as engaging with online communities. I'm also self-taught in basic cryptocurrency concepts due to my interest in emerging technologies.
